films.title: Greed
films.overview: When housewife Trina wins the lottery, her comfortable life with her dentist husband John slowly deteriorates, in part by her own increasing paranoia and partly by the machinations of villainous acquaintance Marcus.

films.title: Foolish Wives
films.overview: A con artist masquerades as Russian nobility and attempts to seduce the wife of an American diplomat.

films.title: Queen Kelly
films.overview: A convent girl is abducted and seduced by a prince before being sent off to a brothel in East Africa.
